purpose: If neither autonomous treatment editor fits a dictionary, test what happens to held-out edits when the editor is explicitly asked to use one.
condition: No successful fitting in either autonomous treatment, and at least $1.25 remains under the cumulative $100 hosted pilot cap. Skip otherwise.
reason_for_selection: The family has 64 hidden targets and asks for a behavioral change. The alias family has only three hidden targets and can often be solved by copying token rows.
comparison: Use the existing same-seed autonomous fit-enabled arm. Both have fit_sae. This follow-up changes the editing instruction and takes one additional sample.
instruction: Fit a small SAE using public prompts of your choice. Use a learned feature to check a hypothesis relevant to this edit, then make your best weight edit and submit within the same turn budget.
scope: Separate exploratory check of the cost and quality of an instructed editing workflow. Excluded from the two-pair availability endpoint. Changes in reward cannot be attributed to the learned features alone.
failure_handling: Retain the first trajectory including budget exhaustion or lack of submission. No reroll.
